commands.checks: Engine-integrity diff against the pinned corrected_census.c (only the documented L<=22 gate lines may differ), the predecessor package's own math check, the predecessor's brute-force cross-check of the extended engine over all small splits and all four budget modes with cap and fail-closed controls, and node-exact replay of all six recorded L20/L18 receipts of the pinned package with the extended binary.

Fresh capped length-22 probes at the nine open splits, compared against the committed RESULT.json session receipt: each recorded-complete split must complete again with the identical node count and zero hits; each recorded-aborted split must abort at the cap with zero hits; the fresh cap must not exceed the recorded cap. A probe counts as a finite split exclusion only when its process exits 0 with complete=true and zero hits; capped runs are lower bounds on the tree size and never exclusions.

notes: C11 compiler with unsigned __int128 required (clang or GCC). No Python dependencies. Default probe cap 2,000,000,000 nodes per split, probes in parallel threads; --probe-cap lowers it (must stay at or below the recorded cap). RESULT.json is the committed receipt and is never rewritten; each run writes LAST-RUN.json. Timing fields are excluded from all equality checks.
